resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal; no document, glyph or pixel payload in either direction.

semantics: Create, edit and delete one raster item or one text block in the open native document. One request is one atomic revision and one undo entry; an effective no-op (same values) publishes nothing, keeps presence, bytes, history and redo, and reports applied=false. The owner allocates the id of a created item (strokeId is sent empty) and reports it. A text patch has no anchorTopLeft member: an edit never re-anchors a block. A locked Drawing layer, a widget layer and a reference scope are refused; an unknown, wrong-kind or missing asset reference is a typed refusal. The retained font provider is consulted at evaluation, not here, and its absence is that provider's typed unavailability. No JS or Paper writer, no optimistic mutation.
